verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting lets users visually define alert rules that are continuously evaluated against multi-source data and automatically send notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, OpsGenie and others. Grafana Cloud can escalate those alerts to on-call responders, and community users confirm relying on the alerting across many data sources. The automated actions shown are mainly notification and escalation, so broader event-driven automation is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: evidence of arbitrary action types (webhooks or automated remediation) beyond notifications, defining rules as code or via API, and detail on event triggers other than metric or log thresholds.
